description: Reuse the checked AtomicCertificate on the exact existing Body. In the universal three-world model ExistsAt w x iff x≤w, reflexivity supplies population and candidate possibility, transitivity supplies downward actuality, and imported Sum2/IsLUB comparison makes each actual family fusion actual. A candidate cannot lie in both disjoint singleton worlds, so none is necessary. The world object is its greatest actual whole; there is no fixed common actual object. The fixed global whole has an actual singleton part where that whole is absent.
